errors.text_span: The pie chart represents the distribution of three categories across four years, from 2017 to 2019.
errors.evidence: The chart represents three years (2017, 2018, 2019), not four years.

errors.text_span: The sizes of the slices appear to be ordered in a descending manner from the largest to the smallest.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered in descending size; they are arranged arbitrarily.
The description does not mention that the numbers of each category are displayed within the slices in parentheses.
The description does not mention the absence of a legend.

errors.text_span: Das Diagramm enthält keinen Legende- oder Prozentsatz-Anweisungen innerhalb der Segmente.
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that there are no percentage annotations within the segments, but the image clearly shows percentages and counts inside each slice.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the labels for the years (2017, 2018, 2019) are positioned outside the pie chart.
